scope: One fixed corrective reference-maturity repetition for all three algorithms. The short-history run remains preliminary evidence, not overwritten. No algorithm, shader, input policy or quality bound changes.
reference_selection: Use the last complete phase cycle: reference_index = len(reference_frames) - phase_count + actual_phase. Validate recorded phase identity. This also preserves old54-world selection.
maturity_review: Report existing-output phase-matched drift between the final two reference cycles and final two stationary main cycles. No new numerical quality threshold is invented. Existing error units/bounds provide scale; if the reference still evolves materially, report the finite-reference limit and stop without another extension or an unsupported motion/ghosting conclusion.
selection: Original target bounds and matched artifact review remain unchanged. No cost evaluation before a valid quality qualification. This is the only corrective warm-up repetition; no sweep or favorable-result retries.
